concerns.text: Task T007 implements the pruning heuristic with inverted logic (`min_cosine_similarity > 0.70`) which contradicts FR-004 that requires removal only when `min_cosine_similarity < 0.70`. This weakens the functional requirement and invalidates the intended pruning intervention.

Task T009 performs a *piecewise logistic regression* whereas the specification (FR-005) explicitly mandates a *piecewise linear regression*. Using a different statistical model weakens the required analysis and breaches the success criterion SC-004.

Task T014’s feasibility test runs only a reduced‑size sweep (library sizes 10 and 30) and does not execute the full factorial experiment required by SC-005. Consequently the compute‑feasibility claim for the full sweep is not demonstrated.
